name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Central sector income support scheme providing direct financial assistance to landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

conditions: Applicant must belong to a landholding farmer family with cultivable land.
Institutional landholders and higher-income tax-paying categories are excluded per scheme guidelines.

application_guidance: Apply online via the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) using Aadhaar, bank account details, and land ownership records, or visit a nearby Common Service Centre (CSC).

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
description: Public health assurance scheme offering cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage to vulnerable families.
benefits: Health insurance cover of up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for hospitalization at empaneled public and private hospitals.

conditions: Intended for economically weaker and SECC-listed rural/urban vulnerable households.
Covers pre-existing conditions from day one; senior citizens aged 70+ are also covered under expanded guidelines.

application_guidance: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or at an Ayushman Arogya Mandir / empaneled hospital with Aadhaar and ration card to generate an Ayushman Card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Housing assistance program helping eligible low-income and middle-income families build or acquire a pucca house.
benefits: Financial assistance or interest subsidy for constructing or purchasing an all-weather house with basic amenities.

conditions: Applicant or family must not already own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Annual household income should fall within EWS (up to Rs. 3 lakh) or LIG (up to Rs. 6 lakh) brackets for primary subsidy categories.

application_guidance: Apply through pmaymis.gov.in (Urban) or local Gram Panchayat / CSC (Gramin) with Aadhaar, income proof, and bank account details.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (National Scholarship Portal)
description: Financial support for students from economically weaker and reserved categories pursuing post-secondary education.
benefits: Covers tuition/compulsory fees and monthly maintenance allowance depending on course level and hosteller/day-scholar status.

conditions: Must be enrolled in Class 11, Class 12, diploma, undergraduate, or postgraduate studies at a recognized institution.
Family annual income typically must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (varies slightly by category scheme).

application_guidance: Register on scholarships.gov.in (NSP), complete One-Time Registration (OTR), and upload income certificate, previous marksheet, and bonafide student certificate.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Micro-credit facility empowering urban street vendors with affordable collateral-free working capital loans.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loans starting at Rs. 10,000 (up to Rs. 50,000 in subsequent tranches) with 7% interest subsidy and digital cashback.

conditions: Applicant must be a street vendor engaged in vending in urban areas.
Requires Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body (ULB) / Town Vending Committee.

application_guidance: Apply online via pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through a nearby CSC/lending bank with Aadhaar, mobile number, and vending certificate.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension scheme focused on unorganized sector workers to provide regular monthly income after age 60.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 starting at age 60 depending on contribution amount.

conditions: Subscriber must be aged between 18 and 40 years with a savings bank or post office account.
Income taxpayers are not eligible to open new APY accounts.

application_guidance: Visit your bank branch or use your bank's net banking / mobile app to submit the APY registration form with Aadhaar and nominee details.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.
benefits: Business loans under Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (up to Rs. 5 lakh), and Tarun (up to Rs. 10 lakh) categories.

conditions: Must have a viable non-farm income-generating business plan in manufacturing, trading, or services.
Applicant should not have any past loan default with banks or financial institutions.

application_guidance: Apply through JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or directly at public/private sector banks, RRBs, or MFIs with ID proof, address proof, and business plan.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: State welfare initiative in Maharashtra providing monthly financial assistance to eligible women for health, nutrition, and economic independence.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 1,500 per month into the beneficiary woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account.

conditions: Resident of Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 and family should not be income tax payers.

application_guidance: Apply via the Nari Shakti Doot app, official Maharashtra state portal, or Anganwadi / Setu Kendra with Aadhaar, domicile/ration card, and income certificate.
